cases.description: Flipping one byte in a packaged deliverable must fail verification.
Missing required release deliverable or SHA256SUMS entry must fail closed.
Release signed by an untrusted or wrong Ed25519 key must be rejected.
Signed release whose provenance_expires_at is before verification time must be rejected.
Replaying revision <= last valid accepted authority revision must be rejected.
Rollback attempting to overwrite newer accepted host data with an older snapshot must be rejected.
